bench 1.0 · generated 2026-11-01

Scored against Word, failures included.

The oracle is Word’s own PDF export of each document (SHA-pinned). A converter’s PDF is scored 0–100 by pixel similarity; redlines are additionally opened in Word and compared against Word’s own compare. Medians and means count a failed document as 0, so no tool gains by skipping a hard one.

† author-affiliated · failures count as 0

Oracle: real Word

Every reference PDF is exported by Microsoft Word and SHA-pinned. Redlines are opened in Word too: if Word refuses the file, the tool scores 0 for that pair.

Intent-to-treat

Failures are not dropped. A crash, a timeout or an unopenable file counts as 0 in ITT mean and median, so a tool cannot improve its rank by skipping hard documents.

Paired bootstrap

Ranks tie (n=) when the paired bootstrap interval of the median difference to the row above includes 0. 2,000 resamples, seed 42.

Release samples

From 0.17.0 the tables on this page are the release’s two samples — state-balanced, every file sha256-listed in the engine’s release_info/. Full-corpus runs remain in the bench’s RESULTS.md.

Author-affiliated, same rules

jubarte is marked † everywhere. Pins, run dates and sample lists are published so any row can be re-run; the harness is public.

Harness and raw records: neurotic_docx_bench. Per-case viewer: https://jandira-tech.github.io/neurotic_docx_bench/. Figures are project-maintained and reproducible, not a neutral third-party benchmark.
